<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang=""><head><meta http-equiv="content-type" content="text/html; charset=UTF-8">
<meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
<link rel="author" href="https://www.niksoggia.it/">
<title>404 - Oggetto non trovato!</title>
<style type="text/css">
:root {
	--color-bod-fg: #eee;
	--color-bod-bg: #fff;
	--color-log-fg: #f40;
	--color-txt-fg: #234;
	--color-txt-bg: url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,");
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
	:root {
		--color-bod-fg: #000;
		--color-bod-bg: #222;
		--color-log-fg: #f80;
		--color-txt-fg: #aaa;
		--color-txt-bg: url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,");
	}
}
body {
	border: 0px;
	margin: 0px;
	padding: 10% 30% 0% 30%;
	font-family: sans-serif;
	color: var(--color-bod-fg);
	background-color: var(--color-bod-bg);
	background-repeat: no-repeat;
	background-position: center top; 
	background-size: 50% auto;
	background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,");
}
@media (max-width: 1600px) {
	body {
		padding: 10% 20% 0% 20%;
		background-size: 80% auto;
	}
}
@media (max-width: 1200px) {
	body {
		padding: 10% 0% 0% 4%;
		background-size: 100% auto;
	}
}
a {
	color: inherit;
	background-color: transparent;
}
a img {
	border: 0px;
}
h1, h2, h3 {
	border: 0px;
	margin: 0px;
	margin-bottom: 0.5em;
	padding: 0px;
	font-style: normal;
	font-weight: normal;
	text-align: left;
}
img.center {
	margin: 0px auto 0px auto;
	display: block;
}
p.center {
	color: var(--color-bod-fg);
	text-align: center;
}
p.center a {
	text-decoration: none;
}
#nik {
	border: 0px;
	border-top: 1px dotted transparent;
	margin: 0px;
	padding: 0px;
	position: relative;
	width: 100%;
	min-height: 80vh;
	color: var(--color-bod-bg);
	background-color: transparent;
	background-repeat: no-repeat;
	background-position: center top; 
	background-size: 100% auto;
	background-image: var(--color-txt-bg);
}
.logo {
	border: 0px;
	margin: 5% 0% 0% 5%;
	padding: 0px;
	font-size: 2.3em;
	float: left;
	color: var(--color-log-fg);
	background-color: transparent;
}
.text {
	border: 0px;
	margin: 5% 12% 0% 15%;
	padding: 0px;
	text-align: justify;
	color: var(--color-txt-fg);
	background-color: transparent;
}
</style>
</head><body><div id="nik">
<div class="logo">&#x26a0;</div>
<div class="text">
<h1><b>404</b> Oggetto non trovato!</h1>


    L'URL richiesto non esiste su questo server.

  

    Se hai scritto l'URL a mano, per favore controlla che
    non ci siano errori.

  

<p><i>Se pensi che questo sia un errore del server, per favore contatta il 
<a href="mailto:info@creaweb.it">webmaster</a>.
</i></p>
<br>
<p class="center"><a href="/" target="_top"><img class="center" width="128" height="110" alt="house" title="Home" src="data:image/svg+xml;base64,">www.nvrcinema.it</a></p>
</div>
</div></body>
